name: Portland Wind Farm
current_developer: Pacific Hydro Portland Wind Farm Pty Ltd
notable: ~195 MW Portland Wind Energy Project across four stages (Cape Bridgewater, Cape Nelson North, Cape Nelson South, Cape Sir William Grant) by Pacific Hydro. One of Australia's oldest continuously developed wind projects, with stages from 2001 to 2015.

timeline.title: Commercial operations commenced
timeline.detail: Commencement date from AEMO registration via OpenElectricity.

timeline.title: First generation recorded
timeline.detail: First market dispatch data recorded in AEMO systems.

eis_specs.document_title: Portland Wind Farm — MP-permit source (v3.31.0 wind tranche 2)
eis_specs.connection_substation_name: Portland (Heywood-Portland 132 kV via aluminium smelter substation)
eis_specs.notes: Regime: MP-permit. Portland Wind Energy Project (PWEP) received Vic planning approvals 2001 for all four capes. This 151.7 MW Registered figure = Cape Bridgewater (58 MW, 29 turbines) + Cape Nelson South (44 MW) + Cape Nelson North/Sir William Grant (47 MW, 23 turbines Stage IV completed 2015). Owned by Pacific Blue (ex Pacific Hydro, SPIC). Yambuk (Stage I) is separate registered unit.
